verdicts.reason: A drops the URL and keeps a stray '|' separator after NOVAK GALLERY. Its date wraps awkwardly ('JUNE 5 TO / JULY 3'), an empty white frame box floats on its own detached from the art, and the dot artwork is cropped against the right edge, so the layout looks broken. B keeps all the original info in a neat left-aligned three-line stack and shows the framed dot artwork intact on the right, but the info lines are cramped and tiny at banner size, and the middle text block is crowded against the art while uneven gaps are left elsewhere.
